newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) up.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) up.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Tuesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell to 1.162 billionh yuan fron Monday's 2.30 billion yuan with the 60-day contract the most active.
Traders said the strong performance of domestic A share markets attracted many non-banking financial institutions which bought through the short-term financial centres mainly in southern provinces.

Selling from major state banks was also active," one trader said, adding "The situation is likely to continue because they have no alternative since the central bank banned state banks from trading treasury bills."
Many traders said the rates would be supported by non-banking financial institutions in the next few days in line with the rally on the A share markets that began last week.
